description: Investment-to-value (ITV) is the price paid for a note, plus any senior liens, divided by the property's value, and this tool computes ITV beside the note's loan-to-value (LTV) and the value cushion behind the investment. It shows the collateral side of a mortgage note value calculation. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

balance.description: Note's unpaid balance, USD (optional, adds LTV).

price.description: Price paid (or being considered) for the note, USD.

senior_liens.description: Balances of liens ahead of this note, USD. Default 0.

name: investment_to_value
title: Investment-to-value (ITV) calculator
